USA.note: World's #1 sorghum exporter. UN Comtrade 2024: ~5,390 kt exports, of which ~5,683 kt (China-reported) went to China for feed and baijiu liquor. USDA FAS PSD MY2024/25 production ~9.1 Mt (Kansas/Texas).

CHN.note: By far the world's largest sorghum importer. UN Comtrade 2024 (China customs): 8,656 kt — USA 5,683, Australia 1,950, Argentina 1,020 kt. For hog/poultry feed and baijiu distilling.

NGA.note: Largest Sub-Saharan sorghum producer; near-entirely consumed domestically as staple food and local brewing. USDA FAS PSD MY2024/25; minimal trade.

ETH.note: Ethiopia does not report to Comtrade 2024; figure from exporter mirror — USA reported 185 kt to Ethiopia in 2024, almost all USDA Title II/WFP in-kind food aid. Production ~5.5 Mt (USDA/FAO), a staple grain.

SDN.note: Sudan does not report to Comtrade 2024 (civil war); import from exporter mirror — USA reported 79 kt in 2024, predominantly emergency food aid. Sorghum is Sudan's primary staple; production war-disrupted (USDA/FAO).

MEX.note: Significant domestic sorghum producer (Tamaulipas, Sinaloa) and net feed-grain importer. UN Comtrade 2024: imports overwhelmingly from the USA. USDA FAS PSD MY2024/25.

ARG.note: Major Southern-Hemisphere sorghum exporter; China is the dominant destination. UN Comtrade 2024 (China customs): 1,020 kt of Argentine sorghum into China. USDA FAS PSD MY2024/25.

AUS.note: Key sorghum exporter, almost exclusively to China for feed/liquor. UN Comtrade 2024 (China customs): 1,950 kt of Australian sorghum into China. USDA FAS PSD MY2024/25.

BRA.note: Rapidly expanding producer (second-crop safrinha in the Cerrado); growing exporter to China and regional feed markets. USDA FAS PSD MY2024/25.

IND.note: Large producer of sorghum (jowar), consumed domestically as food grain and fodder; minimal trade. USDA FAS PSD/FAO MY2024/25.

JPN.note: Feed-grain importer with no domestic sorghum crop. UN Comtrade 2024 (Japan customs): 122 kt imported, ~76 kt from the USA, balance from Argentina.

ERI.note: Eritrea does not report to Comtrade 2024; import from exporter mirror — USA reported 126 kt in 2024, essentially all in-kind food aid. Sorghum is a staple cereal.

flows.note: WITS/UN Comtrade 2024 (China customs): China imported 5,683 kt of sorghum from the USA (HS 1007, gross imports). The single largest sorghum trade flow in the world, for feed and baijiu distilling.
WITS/UN Comtrade 2024 (China customs): China imported 1,950 kt of sorghum from Australia (HS 1007). Australia's crop is almost entirely shipped to China.
WITS/UN Comtrade 2024 (China customs): China imported 1,020 kt of sorghum from Argentina (HS 1007). China is the dominant outlet for Argentine sorghum.
UN Comtrade 2024 (US export mirror): the USA shipped 185 kt of sorghum to Ethiopia (HS 1007). Ethiopia is a non-reporter; overwhelmingly USDA Title II/WFP in-kind emergency food aid.
UN Comtrade 2024 (US export mirror): the USA shipped 126 kt of sorghum to Eritrea (HS 1007), essentially all in-kind food aid. Eritrea is a non-reporter.
UN Comtrade 2024 (US export mirror): the USA shipped 79 kt of sorghum to Sudan (HS 1007), predominantly emergency food aid amid the civil war. Sudan is a 2024 non-reporter.
WITS/UN Comtrade 2024 (Japan customs): Japan imported ~76 kt of sorghum from the USA (HS 1007) for feed use.
UN Comtrade 2024 (US export mirror): the USA shipped 44 kt of sorghum to Mexico (HS 1007) for feed. Mexico reported the value but not the tonnage, so the US-reported quantity is used.
UN Comtrade 2024 (US export mirror): the USA shipped 39 kt of sorghum to South Sudan (HS 1007), essentially all humanitarian food aid. South Sudan is a non-reporter.
UN Comtrade 2024 (US export mirror): the USA shipped 31 kt of sorghum to Djibouti (HS 1007), much transiting onward as regional food aid. Djibouti is a non-reporter for 2024.
UN Comtrade 2024 (US export mirror): the USA shipped 29 kt of sorghum to Somalia (HS 1007), essentially all in-kind food aid. Somalia is a non-reporter.
UN Comtrade 2024 (US export mirror): the USA shipped 23 kt of sorghum to Cameroon (HS 1007), largely food aid for the Lake Chad/Far North region.

rankings.note: Exporter ranks: USA total exports 5,390 kt (UN Comtrade 2024) lead by a wide margin; Argentina ~2,000 kt and Australia 1,950 kt follow. Importer ranks dominated by China at 8,656 kt — over 90% of world sorghum import demand; remaining importers are an order of magnitude smaller and skewed toward East-African food-aid recipients.

global.note: Global sorghum, kt (USDA FAS PSD, marketing-year basis). World output ~59-66 Mt; trade dominated by US→China. The 2024 trade total (~13 Mt) reflects very strong Chinese feed/liquor demand met chiefly by the USA, Australia, Argentina.
